tips.text: Keep your own clan at Ghost tier: build no barracks, finish all the research you want, and only then invite people.
Build only an Oracle, a Tenno Lab, reactors and connectors; you do not need a big dojo.
Join an established clan, buy the researched blueprint for 15,000 credits, and leave; you keep what you bought.
Expect the dojo setup to be the real work; nobody complains about the farm itself.
